component.name: kickFile
component.summary: Move files between your phone and computer over Wi-Fi

description.p: kickFile sends files, photos, videos, folders and text between your Android phone and your computer over your own Wi-Fi or your phone's hotspot. Full quality, encrypted, with no cable, no account and no internet.
Open kickFile on both devices and they find each other. Drag files onto your phone in the kickFile window, or send from the phone to the computer.

ul.li: Works with Android phones and with kickFile on Linux, Windows and Mac
Any size and type, in both directions, nothing compressed
Encrypted, with a 6-digit code to check the first time two devices meet
Every file is checked, and transfers resume after a dropped connection
Connect with a QR code when the network blocks automatic discovery
No servers, no account, no ads, no tracking

screenshot.caption: Drag files onto your phone to send them
Check the 6-digit code once, then trust the device
